payload.body: Does team B's relay carry this too?

notes: Cross-scope target (issue #54's fixture list): an addressee cannot carry its own scope qualification - the ident grammar rejects 'team-b:agent-9', so no cross-scope target is expressible on this wire at all. The frame publishes to exactly one authorized scope; a mention narrows nothing, and narrow delivery would need service-side enforcement that is a separate issue only if integration demonstrates a gap.
